summary: B.Tech Computer Science (AI & Machine Learning) student seeking a Research Intern role in AI and Quantum Algorithms at IBM Research India. Strong Python foundation with two IEEE conference papers in machine learning, hands-on work building LLM agents, evaluation frameworks, and safety layers with LangGraph and MCP, and 5 pull requests merged into Cal.com and freeCodeCamp.

bullets: Shipped a fix for a Day.js UTC/timezone plugin load-order bug on Cal.com, a platform used by 50k+ teams, after tracing the root cause and verifying it with cross-browser testing.
Merged 5 pull requests across Cal.com (github.com/calcom/cal.com) and freeCodeCamp (github.com/freeCodeCamp/freeCode-Camp) after maintainer code review.
Built automated file-structure validation with unit tests for freeCodeCamp workshops and added test coverage for a high-contrast navbar fix.

projects.name: RecoveryOS: Guardrailed AI Decision System
projects.description: Rule-based safety layer for AI agent workflows
bullets: Designed an AI-driven revenue-recovery system in which AI suggestions pass through a rule-based safety layer (risk limits, retry budgets, cooldowns, kill-switch) before any action is taken.

Recovered 20,726 extra across 135 failed-payment test cases with zero unsafe actions and zero duplicate executions, using idempotent execution, a reconciliation ledger, and an append-only audit trail.
Ran controlled, seeded simulations for reproducible results, with 232/232 unit tests and 36/36 validation checks passing in automated release checks.

projects.name: AgentForensics
projects.description: Digital forensics framework for MCP-connected multi-agent systems
bullets: Designed a digital forensics framework for MCP-connected multi-agent systems with four components: EvidenceCollector, ProvenanceGraphBuilder, EscalationDetector, and ForensicReporter.

Evaluated a LangGraph prototype with two MCP tool servers on 20 synthetic agent sessions to analyse agent behaviour: flagged 17/20 escalation events with 0 false positives, reaching 91.3% precision; manuscript drafted for an IEEE conference; open-source (Apache 2.0) release planned.

projects.name: Smart Sales Intelligence Agent
bullets: Built a modular 4-stage multi-agent workflow (Orchestrator → Research → Analysis → Outreach), tracking latency, errors, and usage for each stage.
Added real-time execution timelines so every agent run can be traced and debugged.
